jobs.description:
Design the systems that guide satellites in orbit for new ambitious missions

We are seeking an experienced AOCS/GNC Engineer to design, develop, and validate attitude determination, orbit control, and autonomous navigation solutions for small satellite missions. In this role, you will develop guidance and control strategies across diverse and demanding mission profiles — from VLEO drag-dominated regimes to deep-space trajectories and asteroid proximity operations.

You will join our Advanced Missions global team, developing next-generation AOCS/GNC concepts while collaborating closely with GomSpace's established AOCS team in Aalborg — who built and flew the AOCS for the Juventas CubeSat on ESA's Hera mission and are currently developing full 6-DoF GNC for the Llevant (RAMSES) asteroid rendezvous mission.

**

Your Role**

As AOCS/GNC Engineer, you will own the attitude and orbit control design for advanced mission proposals — from requirements definition and algorithm design through high-fidelity simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design and implement AOCS/GNC algorithms for attitude determination, control, and autonomous navigation across diverse mission profiles.

• Develop guidance and orbit-control strategies tailored to SSA, VLEO drag-dominated regimes, and deep-space trajectories.

• Model and simulate spacecraft dynamics, environmental disturbances, and sensor/actuator performance for mission-specific scenarios.

• Validate algorithms through high-fidelity simulations, Monte-Carlo analyses, and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

• Collaborate with systems, propulsion, and mission design teams to define control requirements and ensure end-to-end stability and performance.

**

What Success Looks Like**

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace's AOCS product portfolio (GSW-600 reaction wheels, Auriga/Twinkle star trackers, STIM300 IMU, AOCS Flightcore software).

• Delivering your first AOCS sizing and mode analysis for a mission proposal and setting up a reusable MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment.

• Establishing working relationships with the Aalborg AOCS team and communicating AOCS trade-offs clearly to non-AOCS stakeholders.

Over time, you will be recognised for owning end-to-end AOCS/GNC design for advanced mission proposals, developing and maintaining GNC strategies across multiple mission regimes, and achieving successful Monte-Carlo validation campaigns that demonstrate algorithm robustness.

**

What You Bring**

You are an AOCS/GNC specialist with deep analytical rigour and a passion for solving complex spacecraft dynamics and control challenges across unconventional mission profiles.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Control Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. A PhD focused on GNC, spacecraft dynamics, or autonomous navigation is a strong plus.

• 3–5+ years of experience in AOCS/GNC algorithm design, simulation, and validation for spacecraft missions.

• Experience with attitude determination (gyro-stellar estimators, EKF/UKF), 3-axis control (sliding mode, PD/PID, LQR), and momentum management.

• Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink for spacecraft dynamics modelling and Monte-Carlo analysis.

• Experience with C/C++ implementation of flight algorithms and familiarity with AOCS sensors and actuators (star trackers, IMUs, reaction wheels, magnetorquers, RCS thrusters).

• Exposure to ESA/ECSS project lifecycle and AOCS design reviews (PDR, CDR) is highly valued.

**

Who You Are**

You combine deep mathematical rigour with creative engineering intuition. You are energised by the challenge of designing control solutions for missions that push the boundaries of what nanosatellites can do.

You are known for:

• Analytical depth — AOCS/GNC demands mathematical precision, and you deliver it.

• Creative problem solving — developing novel control strategies for unconventional mission profiles.

• Collaborative communication — translating complex dynamics and control concepts into clear requirements for systems and propulsion teams.

• Self-driven initiative — comfortable with ambiguity in early-phase mission design.

• Execution discipline – ensuring commitments are met in demanding environments.

• Customer focus – ensuring focus on customer’s success.

• True leadership — taking ownership of your domain and driving technical excellence.

**

Why Join Us**

You will play a key role in shaping future space missions at their most decisive stage. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with leading institutional customers, influence mission architectures from the start, and contribute to programs with long-term strategic impact.

**

Join our mission**

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: Gaetano Livornese, Department Manager. E-mail: gali@gomspace.com

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6 in Aalborg, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

We kindly draw your attention to the fact that we do not receive applications and resumes via e-mail or by personal appearance. This is to protect and show consideration for your personal information. Apply for the job by following the link below.

**

About GomSpace**

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Learn more on www.gomspace.com

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

**

Application deadline:**

As soon as possible

Project Manager, Software Quality - Defence

Do you thrive at the intersection of project management and software quality? Join Defence QA Management and play a key role in driving strategic initiatives, ensuring successful delivery, and strengthening quality across our Defence software products. Leveraging your project management expertise and understanding of software QA, you will create alignment, drive progress, and deliver results. Experience leading people is beneficial but not essential.

The job: drive test strategy, quality improvements and product programme progress

As Project Manager for QA in one of our five product programmes, you will hold the overall QA responsibility for the product programme and lead the QA team within it. Your focus will be to ensure high-quality products by defining, coordinating and supporting test activities across project teams, while working closely with the programme’s other Managers, who lead the Developers. You will lead QA planning, reporting and improvements – creating progress, structure and transparency within the programme. At the same time, you will drive QA initiatives and implement improvements, shaping the direction for quality assurance. You will also people manage a team of QA Engineers – developing their skills, ensuring the right competencies and fostering a motivated, high-performing team.

In addition, you will be part of the QA Programme’s management team, contributing to strategic decisions and helping to guide the programme toward success.

In short, you can look forward to:

• driving and developing the test framework and QA strategies to ensure product quality and scalability

• overseeing the planning and execution of system tests to validate end-to-end functionality

• creating a clear roadmap for continuous test improvements in close collaboration with our QA Programme team

• working closely with key stakeholders including the Directors, Managers and Architects to ensure alignment and quality throughout the development and delivery process

• leading and growing a dedicated testing team – fostering motivation, building capabilities and supporting professional development

You should expect up to 5–10 travel days a year visiting colleagues at our office in Bucharest.

The team: join an international team united by a strong QA mindset

You will report directly to the Senior Manager for Defence QA Management and become part of a product programme with development teams across Aarhus, Copenhagen and Bucharest, working together to bring direction and structure to QA activities. You will play a key part in ensuring high-quality outcomes through strong collaboration.

By joining Defence QA Management, you will also enter a unique community of more than 40 QA Engineers and Test Managers – a strong network where you can share knowledge, learn from experienced colleagues and grow your expertise.

You bring: strong project management experience combined with software QA expertise

To succeed in this role, you bring a proven track record in project management, with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, ensure progress, and deliver outcomes in a structured and collaborative way. Ideally, this is complemented by experience within software quality assurance or test management, providing you with insight into quality practices and software development processes. Previous people leadership experience is a plus, but not a requirement.

We are also looking for:

• a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical or scientific discipline

• strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to navigate complex organisational environments

• a structured and analytical approach to planning, execution, and risk management

• a solid understanding of software development, testing, and release processes

• experience working in agile development environments

• excellent communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken

**

About you**

You have a structured and proactive work style with a passion for software quality and continuous improvement. You excel at creating alignment across stakeholders and driving initiatives to successful outcomes.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, games tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits such as free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be both professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today.

If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Rebecca Johannsen, Senior Manager, Product QA Programme.

Please be aware, that response times may be longer due to summer holidays.

jobs.description:
The Company

COWI is a leading international consultancy within engineering, architecture, energy, and the environment. In close collaboration with clients, COWI co-creates innovative and sustainable solutions that enhance quality of life for current and future generations. With a primary presence in Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, North America, and India, COWI employs approximately 7,500 professionals who bring expertise across a wide range of disciplines.

If you are curious to learn more, we invite you to explore some of COWI’s featured projects at www.cowi.com or view their global portfolio at: Projects around the world (cowi.com)

On behalf of COWI, Best Talent is now seeking an Associate Project Director.

The organisation & the Team

COWI’s Building & Industry Executing Unit in Denmark, consists of approximately 1050 professionals and specialists across building related disciplines.

Within this framework, you will be part of a dedicated Multidisciplinary Project Management team in Lyngby, consisting of approximately 38 committed colleagues. This structure ensures a strong, supportive, and highly professional environment focused on excellence in project delivery.

As part of this strong professional community, you will work alongside dedicated, talented, and ambitious colleagues who are strongly committed to excellence in project leadership and management. Moreover, you will have the opportunity to realize your full potential within an inclusive and supportive professional environment.

Associate Project Director

Exiting Multidisciplinary Building Projects – From Design to Execution

• Strong focus on clients and project delivery

• Thrive in a collaborative and supportive culture

• Shape your own professional development

• Contribute to a more sustainable and livable world

The Challenge

As Associated Project Director for construction projects in Denmark, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management of building projects—from initial planning through to execution. Your role will encompass quality assurance, budget control, contractual and financial oversight, as well as the coordination of timelines and resources.

You will also act as the key liaison with clients and collaborate closely with stakeholders such as public authorities, contractors, and design partners.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading new construction and renovation projects from concept to completion

• Participating in large-scale projects as part of a broader project management team

• Managing complex stakeholder environments, clients, authorities, contractors, and design partners

• Maintain close collaboration with clients to ensure their needs and expectations are consistently met

• Overseeing project scope, schedule, risks, and cost management

• Ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and sustainability across all project stages

• Driving cross-disciplinary collaboration across COWI’s teams and geographies

• Contributing to the professional development of project team members

Why join COWI?

At COWI, your work contributes to shaping a sustainable and liveable world. By combining deep knowledge, curiosity, and courage, COWI develops solutions that address today’s challenges and enable a better tomorrow. COWI has committed to phasing out fossil-based projects and aspires for 100% of its revenue to stem from sustainability-focused initiatives.

COWI values diversity, continuous development, and a sense of belonging. They foster a supportive and enjoyable workplace, knowing that a healthy work-life balance enhances performance both professionally and personally. You will report to the Vice President of the group and be offered a competitive compensation package, aligned with your experience and qualifications.

Your profile & Talent:

You are an experienced Multidisciplinary Project Manager who thrives in collaboration with colleagues, partners, and clients. You foster strong relationships through integrity, accountability, and a proactive mindset. Your background has equipped you to confidently lead medium- to large-scale design projects.

Qualifications and key competencies:

• A relevant academic background in civil engineering, architecture, or a related discipline

• Professional experience in Denmark, with in-depth knowledge of all phases of the Danish building project lifecycle

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex project environments

• A proactive and structured approach to work, with keen attention to detail

• A self-motivated and inspiring personality that promotes teamwork and positive dynamics

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written

Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is a core value at COWI, and inclusion is a strategic priority. The company is committed to fostering a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities for growth. Leaders at COWI are expected to model inclusive behaviour and embrace diverse perspectives as a strength in team formation and decision-making processes. These commitments are not only embedded in COWI’s values—they are part of what the company believes is the right thing to do.

Application

Best Talent is managing the recruitment process and will treat all applications with strict confidentiality.

Please send your application in English, marked “1920/Associated Project Director, COWI”, to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible due to the urgency of this position. For more information about Best Talent, please visit www.besttalent.dk.

Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

Do you want your engineering skills to directly shape how athletes understand and improve their movement? Are you excited by the opportunity of turning noisy, high-dimensional data into clean, actionable biomechanical metrics used by professionals and ambitious amateurs alike?

We are looking for an Algorithm Developer in Mathematical modelling to join our Motion Analysis team. You’ll work at the intersection of deep learning and real-world sports science, taking the raw output of our AI models and building the modelling and post-processing pipelines that make the data real. This is where the engineering meets the athlete.

As a member of our team, you will be responsible for the key step between AI prediction and product output. Our deep learning models produce body key points from video. Your job is to turn those noisy, uncertain estimates into robust skeletal fits and reliable biomechanical metrics that our users can trust and act on.

We believe it takes careful post-processing and modelling to turn raw deep learning predictions into data that is real, reliable, and actionable. You will design and develop custom algorithms that handle outlier detection, optimization, and human body model fitting, often as one integrated modelling approach rather than separate steps. You will be part of an agile, collaborative team, contributing to solutions from prototype to production and helping shape our products. You will join a team of six, with diverse backgrounds spanning deep learning, computer vision, software engineering, and mathematical modelling.

We work in a collaborative environment where team members support each other and share responsibility for moving projects forward. We believe that strong solutions emerge through open dialogue across disciplines. We also value a positive and engaging work environment, where curiosity is encouraged and people can explore problems that interest them alongside supportive colleagues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Designing and implementing mathematical models that fit skeletal structures to noisy key point data, balancing input uncertainty with anatomical constraints.

• 
Developing robust outlier detection and rejection methods that work within the modelling framework, not just as a pre-processing step.

• 
Building and refining optimization pipelines for post-processing deep learning outputs into accurate biomechanical metrics.

• 
Conducting data analysis and statistical validation to understand model performance and propose improvements.

• 
Collaborating closely with our deep learning engineers and software engineers to ensure your models integrate cleanly into the broader product pipeline.

• 
Exploring and evaluating new approaches from research literature, adapting them to our specific problem domain and data characteristics.

Job requirements

• 
A master's degree or PhD in Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related technical field with strong mathematical foundations.

• 
Solid skills in mathematical modelling, you are comfortable formulating real-world problems as optimization, estimation, or fitting problems.

• 
Strong foundations in linear algebra, statistics, and numerical methods.

• 
Experience working with noisy, real-world data,you understand uncertainty and know how to handle it.

• 
Programming skills in Python - Familiarity with C++ is a plus.

• 
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and are driven by making your work matter in a real product, not just in a report.

• 
Communication skills, with the ability to explain mathematical choices to colleagues from different technical backgrounds.

Preferably:

• 
Experience with signal processing methods such as filtering, smoothing, or time-series analysis.

• 
Familiarity with constrained optimization techniques and solvers.

• 
Experience with human body modelling, biomechanics, or motion capture data.

• 
Exposure to deep learning, not necessarily training models, but understanding what they output and why they fail.

• 
A genuine passion for applying mathematical thinking to solve real-world challenges.

• 
An interest in sports like golf, baseball, or others is a bonus!

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer – Manufacturing, Automation & Applied AI
jobs.description:
Hartmann Packaging A/S – Lyngby, Denmark

Would you like to apply Artificial Intelligence where it creates real-world impact in manufacturing?

Hartmann is looking for an AI Engineer to help accelerate the adoption of AI, machine learning, and automation across our global organization. This role will play a key part in transforming how we optimize manufacturing performance, operational processes, and data-driven decision-making through practical AI solutions.

You will join Hartmann’s Data, Analytics & AI team and become part of a growing digital transformation agenda where AI is expected to become a key enabler of operational excellence, process improvement, and future competitiveness.

It a experimentation role and a hands-on engineering position for someone who wants to develop, deploy, and scale AI solutions that create measurable business value in real operational environments.

The Role

As AI Engineer, you will become part of Hartmann’s Data, Analytics & AI team, reporting to the Head of Data, Analytics & AI, Jan Boldt.

You will work closely with stakeholders across Production, Digital Manufacturing, Global Process Excellence, Enterprise Systems, and Business Functions to identify opportunities where AI can simplify work, improve process quality, reduce manual effort, and create measurable business outcomes.

Your primary focus will be on manufacturing and operational excellence, helping Hartmann leverage AI, machine learning and automation to improve production performance, quality, process stability, waste reduction and operational decision-making across our factories.

While the role will also contribute to forecasting, planning and commercial analytics initiatives, the core mission is to unlock value from production and operational data and turn AI into a practical capability within Hartmann’s manufacturing environment.

Beyond developing solutions, you will play a key role in helping colleagues across the organization understand, adopt and utilize AI effectively. Success in this role will therefore not only be measured by the solutions you build, but also by your ability to increase AI awareness, capability and confidence throughout the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled solutions that improve manufacturing performance and operational excellence

• Build machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions based on production and operational data

• Identify opportunities for AI, automation, and machine learning during process design and continuous improvement initiatives

• Develop AI agents, intelligent workflows, and decision-support solutions

• Translate operational challenges and business needs into scalable AI use cases

• Support predictive analytics initiatives related to forecasting, planning, and optimization

• Collaborate closely with Data & Analytics, Global Process Excellence, Digital Manufacturing, and Enterprise Systems teams

• Drive AI adoption through training, workshops, and hands-on support for business users

• Ensure AI solutions are reliable, secure, explainable, and aligned with responsible AI principles

• Contribute to the development of Hartmann’s AI governance, standards, and best practices

We Imagine You Bring

• Experience developing AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics solutions from concept to implementation

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python

• Experience with modern AI technologies including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and automation platforms

• Understanding of machine learning, data engineering, APIs, and cloud-based AI services

• Experience translating business challenges into practical technology solutions

• Strong communication skills and the ability to engage non-technical stakeholders

• A hands-on approach and willingness to move from prototype to production deployment

It is considered an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Manufacturing or industrial environments

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer (Linux, Rust, Python, C)
jobs.description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

At the heart of our technology is an embedded Linux–based camera system that records sports matches using multiple sensors. Using our advanced video processing algorithms, these streams are stitched together to present one continuous playfield.

Our AI and cloud teams then process the video using proprietary models that lead the industry in our field, enabling players and coaches to access detailed statistics such as goals, ball possession, passes, and more.

While dedicated teams own most of the video processing and AI development, you will interface closely with both worlds and have the opportunity to gain exposure across these domains.

Most work in this role focuses on Rust- and Python-based user-space Linux applications, Linux platform engineering, and firmware architecture, rather than low-level hardware or driver development. Our firmware stack primarily uses Rust, Python, and C, and fluency in at least two of these languages is preferred.

What You Will Do

• Develop and maintain Rust- and Python-based user-space applications running on Veo’s embedded Linux camera platform.

• Contribute to firmware architecture and Linux platform engineering for our camera system.

• Build and maintain integrations with cloud services, including REST APIs, OpenTelemetry, and AWS S3.

• Implement wireless communication features using BLE and Wi-Fi for connectivity with mobile devices.

• Develop and maintain application-layer protocols, including GATT services, Protobuf-based communication, and data serialization.

• Collaborate closely with AI, video processing, and cloud teams to support the broader camera platform.

• Improve system reliability and observability through diagnostics, state management, and monitoring.

What You Could Bring

• At least 5 years of experience and a background in electrical or software engineering.

• Strong foundation in modern software development practices, architecture, and design patterns.

• Experience building and evolving user-space applications in Rust or Python, with a focus on clean APIs, testability, and maintainability across an embedded device fleet.

• Experience developing software for embedded Linux systems (Yocto), including system services, D-Bus, device trees, state management, and diagnostics.

• Experience integrating embedded systems with cloud services such as REST APIs, OpenTelemetry, and AWS S3, including debugging and operational troubleshooting.

• Experience building applications that integrate BLE and Wi-Fi, including GATT services, connection management, Protobuf-based protocols, and communication with mobile devices.

• Familiarity with MCU development and RTOS environments are a nice to have. While most work happens in Linux user-space, exposure to low-level firmware or peripheral interfacing can be helpful when interacting with MCU firmware.

Environment

• Languages: Rust, Python, C

• Embedded Linux: Yocto / OpenEmbedded / meta-tegra

• RTOS: Zephyr

• Cloud & Observability: AWS S3, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loggly

• Infrastructure: NixOS

• Tooling: GitHub (Actions)

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Tembi is building the intelligence layer for European e-commerce.

We monitor more than 1 million online retailers across Europe and transform billions of datapoints into market intelligence that helps logistics providers, retailers and technology companies understand where the market is moving before their competitors do.

The next generation of market intelligence will not be built on static reports and dashboards. It will be built on continuously evolving data pipelines, AI-assisted enrichment, and systems capable of turning fragmented web signals into trusted commercial insight at scale.

We are at a rare moment in the company’s journey:

the market opportunity is large, our product is gaining traction across Europe, and the engineering team is still small enough that great engineers leave fingerprints on everything they build.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong foundations in Python, infrastructure, data engineering and large-scale data systems to help us build the core of that platform.

The team you’ll join

You will join a tight-knit engineering team of software engineers and data engineers working closely together to evolve our Market Intelligence platform.

We work with flat hierarchies, short decision paths and high ownership. Engineers at Tembi work closely with Product, Customer Success and customers themselves to understand real problems and ship solutions that create value quickly.

This is not an environment where engineers disappear into narrow silos or spend months building in isolation. We value pragmatic execution, strong collaboration and people who enjoy solving difficult problems head-on.

Large-scale data processing pipelines

Why you’ll enjoy it here

We move fast, but we care deeply about building reliable systems and long-term value.

We care more about curiosity, responsibility and impact than prestige or corporate titles.

Compensation and growth

We are a startup building for long-term impact, not a large corporation optimising for hierarchy and process.

This role is best suited for engineers motivated by ownership, meaningful technical challenges, customer impact and the opportunity to help shape a growing platform and engineering culture from the inside.

Compensation is tailored individually based on experience, responsibilities and team fit.

Application process

We aim to move quickly while making thoughtful decisions for both the candidate and the team.

This is not a consultancy opportunity, and we respectfully ask not to be contacted regarding consultancy offers.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

As a Senior Project Manager within Process Automation, you will be part of our large project portfolio in Kalundborg. You will play an important role in ensuring the successful execution of our deliveries and will be in close contact with both internal and external stakeholders.

As part of your role, you will maintain close dialogue with your team on-site and participate in regular meetings across disciplines, ensuring transparency, efficiency, and execution according to our plans.

The technical focus of this position is Process Automation, working with DCS 800xA and ECS solutions interfacing with new technologies within the Industry 4.0 domain and Manufacturing IT solutions. Our projects cover the entire project lifecycle, from conceptual and basic design phases to on-site testing activities, including FAT, Interface Testing, Wet Testing, SAT, and UAT, culminating in handover to our customers.

Based on your skills and experience, several opportunities are available within our portfolio.

How you might spend your days

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

• Executing projects within your area in close collaboration with your team, identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

• Focusing on overall project planning, ensuring delivery quality, and planning the necessary resources to maintain schedule and cost targets.

• Estimating costs and planning budgets in collaboration with our engineers and specialists.

• Managing project scope and ensuring that changes are analysed and agreed upon with stakeholders.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Work across the boundaries and you like to work in a diverse and international environment

• Create results through efficient project management and communication, leveraging from your relations to your team and stakeholder

• Have a personal commitment, known for your effectiveness and an open management style and know the impotency to win as a team

• Are fluent in English both written and spoken

What you bring to the role

To be successful in this role, we expect you to have the following experience and educational background:

• An educational background at bachelor's level or a similar relevant technical background.

• 6–10 years of experience with a proven track record in DCS and ECS/PLC Process Automation projects, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience with GMP project execution and preferable knowledge with S88 and S95

• Experience in executing Process Automation projects in collaboration with other disciplines, such as mechanical and process design, as well as end users.

• Experience with on-site commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, and UAT.

• Project Management certification, e.g. PMP or PRINCE2, is preferred.

If you do not meet all the requirements, you are still welcome to apply and provide alternative experience that you believe would be valuable in this role.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, it means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

We are Playdead, an independent game company based in the heart of Copenhagen, Denmark. We have made two critically acclaimed titles, LIMBO and INSIDE. Our current project is a 3rd-person science fiction adventure rendered in a realistic but markedly stylised manner.

Job description

We are seeking an experienced and passionate texture and material artist with both outstanding digital painting skills and a strong technical foundation. You will be responsible for hand-painting key textures as well as designing materials for the game, stylised in accordance with the art direction. You will build and set up high quality materials in Unreal Engine and collaborate with the art team and other departments to prototype materials and ensure continuity with visual style. Your technical know-how will enable you to give consideration to game performance and overcoming technical constraints in the pipeline. You should be willing to work at the Playdead office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

You should be willing to work at the Playdead office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

What will you be doing?

• Hand-paint high quality textures for a variety of organic and structural surfaces

• Author and enhance Materials in Unreal Engine for the production team to use

• Unwrap and texture 3D assets

• Establish material workflows and pipelines that will be used by the art team to always ensure high-fidelity and continuity with the visual quality of the textures and materials

• Evaluate material and texture performance and provide creative or technical solutions to optimise and meet the project performance requirements

• Collaborate with artists, designers and programmers to find creative and technical solutions to resolve difficulties on the project

Required Skills & Experience

• Professional experience within 3D game production, working with materials & textures using any major game engine

• Exceptional digital painting skills and a highly developed artistic sensibility

• Experience with texture creation tools such as Substance Designer/Painter, ZBrush, 3D Modelling Tools & Adobe Creative Cloud

• Great communication skills and ability to work effectively on shared project

Desired skills & Experience

• Experience with Unreal Engine

• Skills with establishing workflows and pipelines for material and texture creation

• Eye for quality control and detail

• Passion for architecture, design and art

• Ability to take direction, collaborate with other developers, and give/receive constructive feedback

Who We Are

We are a team of more than 100 creative professionals. We experiment and collaborate with a focus on creating new experiences, and as such we are looking for people who can help us achieve them.

Our approach to development does not include crunching towards arbitrary deadlines - instead, we particularly look for talented people who enjoy managing their own schedule and thrive on working within a friendly, collaborative environment.

We are seeking an experienced Technical Artist to join Playdead’s art team. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills working with Unreal Engine, who thrives on finding innovative solutions to the challenges of simulating a large, fully open world game.

Your responsibility as a Technical Artist will be to support other artists on the team with the technical aspects of the art pipeline, to develop various simulated systems in an open world, and to act as a bridge between art and other disciplines. This may include the creation of Unreal shader graphs, the development of blueprint-based tooling, working with environmental simulations (such as weather, water, sand, etc), and generally assisting with all technical art challenges in our open world game. For all of these tasks, you will work closely with the animators, programmers, sound designers and artists here at Playdead. We are particularly looking for a colleague who enjoys setting their own goals and taking responsibility for their own schedule.

We are working within a highly focused and ambitious vision, which requires adapting to the existing visual style while contributing your own ideas to the whole. More than anything, we are looking for someone who is excited about all facets of game development, as well as being passionate about gaming overall.

What will you be doing?

• Working within a small but dynamic art team, supporting the technical aspects of the art pipeline.

• Developing and supporting environmental simulations, such as water, weather, sand, etc.

• Being the technical bridge between art, animation, programming and sound to help bring an immersive world to life.

• Collaborating with a dedicated team with high ambitions about visual and thematic design.

Required Skills

• Experience with Unreal Engine 5 is required.

• Professional working experience within a 3D game production.

• A strong portfolio of work which demonstrates a level of mastery in various aspects of technical art.

• Comfortable using digital tools and software to find innovative solutions for simulating an open world game, with an art style we describe as “stylized realism.”

• This is a full time position at our studio in Copenhagen, Denmark so you need to be willing to relocate (we offer full relocation support).

Desired Skills

• Some experience and competence with C++ is highly preferred

• Great communication skills and ability to work effectively on shared projects.

• Familiarity with other major game engines.

**Job description

Towards completion of a game, you will be responsible for the final quality of the game - fixing bugs, profiling and optimising code on all levels.

You will be able to define your own goals and tasks.

• You have relevant professional experience shipping other AAA titles or building game engines/graphics technology.

• Great communication skills and ability to work effectively on shared projects.

• A formal education in computer science or graphics - or equivalent work experience

• Experience with engine and console development - hobby engines count.

• A keen eye for aesthetics.
